admission.capacityNote: No cap and no selection procedure. The page carries no numerus fixus statement and no capacity, and the deadline is the ordinary one: 1 May 2027 for an EU/EEA or Swiss applicant, 1 April 2027 for everyone else.

requirements.label: A full IB Diploma

officialWording.text: To qualify for admission to a bachelor's programme at Maastricht University (UM), you must hold a secondary school diploma that is considered equivalent to the Dutch pre-university VWO diploma.

requirements.note: Nuffic compares the full IB Diploma to a VWO diploma. Maastricht warns separately that being VWO-equivalent does not by itself satisfy a programme's additional subject requirements, which are assessed on their own. On Course Results specifically, Maastricht says nothing at all: its diploma list names the "International Baccalaureate Diploma, at least 3 Higher Level (HL) subjects" and no page on the site mentions DP Course Results, an IB Certificate or a partial IB. That silence is not permission — the requirement is a diploma, and Nuffic compares Course Results to vwo-deelcertificaten, which are not one.
requirements.alternativeRoute: It does not close this one to you, though the door is age-gated. Maastricht publishes a Colloquium Doctum on this programme's own admission page, under the heading "Applicants without the required diploma and 21 years of age or older": if you are 21 or older at the start of the academic year, you can still qualify by passing it. You apply by selecting the highest level of previous education you have completed in Studielink, then uploading a personal statement in the MyApplication portal saying you are applying on the basis of the Colloquium Doctum, together with your transcripts, and you ask dacs-admissions@maastrichtuniversity.nl what the assessment consists of — the page does not publish its content, its date or its cost. What it costs at the UM faculties that do publish it is 100 euro, sat in person in Maastricht, applied for through Studielink from 1 October and completed by 15 January. Two doors that are shut whatever your age: Maastricht "does not accept Foundation Programmes for admission to a bachelor's programme", and it "does not accept equivalency statements", so a Nuffic credential evaluation of your Course Results will not stand in for the diploma. Retaking to be awarded the full IB Diploma is the only route that reaches this at eighteen. One further route is national rather than this institution's, and it is the only one that produces the qualification itself instead of an exemption from it: the Dutch staatsexamen vwo. Anyone who registers may sit vwo subjects one at a time with DUO — registration for the 2027 examinations runs from 15 October to 31 December 2026, each subject costs 144 euro with a ceiling of 720 euro a year, and the certificates stay valid for ten years, so the package can be built up and exchanged for a vwo diploma at the end. No age limit applies, which is what makes it different from every colloquium doctum above, and Dutch law lets the College voor Toetsen en Examens grant you ontheffing from individual subjects on the strength of International Baccalaureate results — the one place in Dutch education law where the IB is named. The bill is linguistic: by statute the examinations are sat in Dutch.

alternativeRouteSummary.short: From 21: Maastricht's colloquium doctum for this programme. At 18, only the full Diploma reaches it.

requirements.label: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches at HL

officialWording.text: Data Science and Artificial Intelligence — Mathematics Analysis and Approaches HL

requirements.note: Applications and Interpretation is not accepted at either level for this programme, though the same university accepts it at SL for International Business. Missing this is not necessarily the end: Maastricht calls it a mathematics deficiency and publishes routes to clear it before the first year starts, with a syllabus deadline of 1 June 2027 for EU/EEA applicants.
requirements.alternativeRoute: Maastricht calls this a mathematics deficiency and publishes routes to clear it before the first year starts; the syllabus deadline for EU/EEA applicants is 1 June 2027.

requirements.label: Documented English proficiency
requirements.note: Maastricht resolves the English requirement through an interactive questionnaire on the programme page rather than by publishing a list, so the exact wording of the IB exemption could not be captured. It is recorded as satisfied by a full IB Diploma taught in English, which is how every other institution in this catalogue treats it, and flagged here as the one requirement on this Opportunity that rests on a pattern rather than on a quoted sentence. Confirm it on the programme page.

officialRequirementsText.text: Data Science and Artificial Intelligence — Mathematics Analysis and Approaches HL

notes: The counter-example in this catalogue: a hard IB subject requirement and no competition at all. Meet Mathematics AA HL, apply by 1 May, and you are in.
A mathematics deficiency is a procedure here rather than a refusal. Maastricht assesses it, tells you, and offers ways to clear it before September.
Both the subject requirement and the deadlines are published for 2027-2028.
